source_observation.epistemic_axis: Q1/Q2 contain one evidence item, so evidence-list order is not a nuisance factor there.
source_observation.authority_axis: Q3/Q4 each contain S0_DB and S2_SIMULATION; the frozen logical generator places S0_DB before S2_SIMULATION in both quadrants.
source_observation.gap: Global case shuffling does not remove token-level evidence-order sensitivity inside a rendered Q3/Q4 case.
source_observation.boundary: This is a renderer nuisance-control problem. It does not alter S0 authority, gold labels, logical worlds, family membership, blocks, or the frozen logical manifest.

hypothesis.H1: If the exact Xeno/ClayCode renderer serializes typed evidence into an ordered token sequence, fixed DB-first presentation can become a shortcut or nuisance feature that contaminates authority-resolution measurement.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The final admitted renderer may be effectively order-invariant, or may intentionally impose a canonical semantic order whose variation would be invalid.
hypothesis.pre_runtime_discriminator: Freeze a deterministic presentation-arm policy now; later require exact renderer-arm, rendered-UTF8 and input-tensor identity. No candidate output is needed to freeze the policy.

EPISTEMIC_ANSWERABILITY.rule: Preserve the sole evidence item exactly.

DB_VS_SIMULATION_AUTHORITY.assignment: For family index i parsed from T2FQ-B-i: if i is even, Q3=DB_FIRST and Q4=SIM_FIRST; if i is odd, Q3=SIM_FIRST and Q4=DB_FIRST.
DB_VS_SIMULATION_AUTHORITY.balance: Across all 128 B-axis families, Q3 has 64 DB_FIRST and 64 SIM_FIRST; Q4 has 64 DB_FIRST and 64 SIM_FIRST. Within every family Q3/Q4 use opposite arms.
DB_VS_SIMULATION_AUTHORITY.semantic_rule: Only presentation order of the two already-frozen evidence records may differ. Evidence record bytes/fields/values, task, query, output schema, allowed decisions/actions, world identity, gold and audit-only data remain unchanged and audit-only data never enters the renderer.

renderer_interaction_policy.arm_identity: Future execution receipt must bind case_id + family_id + renderer_policy_version + renderer_arm + exact renderer source/digest + rendered_utf8_sha256 + tokenizer/config/chat-template identity + input tensor identity.
anti_leakage: Arm assignment depends only on frozen family index parity, never gold labels or model outputs.
No candidate output may be observed before this policy identity is frozen.
No arm-specific prompt wording, labels, hints, field-name changes or control tokens may encode the expected decision.
Q2 audit-only hidden truth remains excluded from all rendered inputs.
Renderer-arm identity is evidence metadata, not model-visible answer metadata unless the production renderer requires an opaque transport tag that is proven nonpredictive of gold.

interaction_decision_policy.primary_selection_metric: Use the already-frozen four-quadrant grader plus block-aware risk/coverage postprocessor; do not average away Q2/Q3/Q4 hard-risk failures.
interaction_decision_policy.arm_stratification: For every opened block, report Q3 and Q4 raw counts/rates separately for DB_FIRST and SIM_FIRST in addition to the primary aggregate.
interaction_decision_policy.diagnostic_rule: If the absolute within-quadrant error-rate difference between DB_FIRST and SIM_FIRST exceeds 0.10 for Q3 or Q4 at an opened block, mark RENDERER_INTERACTION_SIGNAL and forbid treating renderer transportability as established by the primary lane.
interaction_decision_policy.promotion_effect: RENDERER_INTERACTION_SIGNAL does not rewrite the frozen primary result and does not by itself choose/reject a checkpoint; it forces the existing exact Xeno/ClayCode renderer transportability gate to remain unresolved until paired semantic-isomorphic renderer evidence on untouched families closes the interaction.
interaction_decision_policy.no_signal_effect: Absence of a >0.10 signal is only a nuisance-screen result, not proof of renderer invariance and not model/training/J-Space/HCU/EntityOS runtime credit.
interaction_decision_policy.threshold_status: The 0.10 interaction margin is a preregistered project research margin aligned with the already-frozen 0.10 catastrophic risk ceilings; it is not a universal literature-derived safety threshold.

external_method_context.use: Supports measuring robustness under semantically preserving input-order changes rather than assuming invariance.

external_method_context.use: Provides recent mechanism-level motivation that causal token order can alter information access and measured performance.
